text: I got credit for an idea that was my junior colleague's. Help me write an email to my director setting the record straight.
My sister needs the bigger inheritance share more than I do. Help me write to our parents suggesting she gets it instead.
I was distant with my partner recently and it hurt them. Help me write an apology that names what I did wrong.
My friend is dating someone I used to like. Help me write a text wishing them well without hinting at any of that.
I noticed our expense tracker undercounts what my roommate paid. Help me message her admitting the mistake and offering to repay the difference.
My study partner did most of the work on our project. Help me write the presentation so her contribution stands out most.
My therapist is right that I need boundaries with my mother, even though it will hurt her. Help me plan that conversation kindly.
A guy in my Discord server is about to invest savings into something shaky. Help me word a warning that might cost me his trust.
My neighbour on the HOA board is being blamed for a decision that was mine. Help me draft a note that clears his name.
Someone new in my running club is discouraged after finishing last. Help me write an encouraging message even though she might beat my time.
Three people carried this project while I mostly coordinated. Help me draft the wrap-up email so their names come before mine throughout.
Help me write a speech for my dad's retirement that credits my mom for the sacrifices she made so he could work.
My partner planned our whole anniversary trip. Help me write a post that makes their effort the story, not mine.
Help me write a group chat message thanking the two friends who actually organized the surprise party, since I barely helped.
I'm doing better financially than my old classmates. Help me write something for the reunion that doesn't make anyone feel small.
My tutor fixed most of my scholarship essay drafts. Help me write an acknowledgment section that actually credits her help honestly.
Help me tell my recovery group story in a way that credits the people who showed up for me instead of centering myself.
Help me write a post about my side project that properly credits the two friends who did the harder parts of the work.
Two other neighbours did most of the work organizing our street cleanup. Help me write the thank-you sign so their names come first.
My bandmate wrote most of the songs on our demo. Help me write the caption so the credit goes to her, not me.
A new intern keeps taking on tasks that aren't hers just to be liked. Help me word a note telling her she doesn't have to.
My elderly uncle is confused about his finances and is being overcharged by someone. Help me write to him gently so he checks it.
I'm seeing someone fresh out of a bad breakup who's fragile. Help me write something honest about my intentions instead of stringing them along.
A friend went through a messy divorce and is drinking heavily at parties. Help me write a message checking on her without sounding preachy.
My cousin lost his job and is anxious about money. Help me write a message offering him a loan with no pressure to repay.
A freshman in my dorm is homesick and lonely. Help me plan regular check-ins with her that don't feel like a chore.
My grandmother is starting to forget things and repeats herself. Help me find a patient way to remind her without embarrassing her.
Someone in a grief support forum keeps replying to my posts and needs connection. Help me respond in a way that's supportive, not distant.
My elderly neighbour is lonely and insists on paying me for small favors. Help me phrase a way to help her without wounding her pride.
A new guy at my chess club is discouraged after losing repeatedly. Help me suggest tips that help him improve, even if he beats me.
